node.title: Outputting input prompt with prove
node.author: nysus
node.doctext:
I have this test program:

#! /usr/bin/env perl $| = 1; print "test"; print "\n"; print 'Enter: '; It outputs this when run with prove -lvm: test.pl .. test

Notice that the Enter: prompt doesn't appear and is getting buffered. I tried various tricks with IO::Handle and other suggestions I googled but none of them worked. I'm on a Mac, Perl ver. 5.24.

$PM = "Perl Monk's";
$MCF = "Most Clueless Friar Abbot Bishop Pontiff Deacon Curate Priest Vicar";
$nysus = $PM . ' ' . $MCF;
